title: KNOW-042 real HTTP cache and controlled tenant lifecycle

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Alice uses an isolated browser profile with the synthetic identity and permissions defined for this case
2. And Alice has catalog permission for the synthetic tile with exact title "T-CACHE"
3. And The browser cache contains a completed T-CACHE V1 load
4. And The controlled server now serves tile entry and referenced chunks "V2"
5. When Alice reloads the browser page containing the portal
6. And Alice clicks the text "New Tile" on the portal workspace page
7. Then the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" is visible on the portal workspace page
8. When Alice clicks the text "T-CACHE" in the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options"
9. Then The T-CACHE fixture tile-version marker equals "V2"
10. And No active T-CACHE content displays the tile-version marker "V1"

annotations.description: Actual current React shell and real Chromium HTTP cache. Local HTTP fixture server supplies synthetic Alice, permissions, base entry wrapper, container, tile, trade, lazy content, CSS and images. V1/V2 markers identify controlled fixture assets. No browser routing, production CDN, real business tenant, or changed base binary acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
